clips.text: The effort is futile because whatsoever is known once is known forever and you cannot be the old ignorant person again.
There is no way to go back and there is no bridge.
This escape will make you more mature too and you will come back strengthened through it and because of it.
Now relax there under the sky and beside the sea and I will be there Whenever you are relaxed you will feel my presence.
And when you feel like coming, come back - and soon you will feel this.
I will be waiting here for you as ever.
Come and continue the arduous journey towards your self
